statement: On summon click run to the left side of the map and summon towers as fast as possible.

creator: nocturne
statement: Order: Frozone tower next to portal then Voidinator then Kraken then Poisonic Elder then another Kraken then a Frozone tower.

creator: nocturne
statement: Summon the first towers quickly otherwise one or two mobs might slip by.

creator: nocturne
statement: Run to the right side and place five Party Starters on the top ledge and level them to 10 with trait A.

creator: nocturne
statement: Always summon 10 waves at a time to get the biggest benefit from the Equinox Slow Roast Whiz bonus.

creator: nocturne
statement: Always summon 10 waves at a time to get the biggest benefit from the Equinox Slow Roast Whiz bonus.

creator: nocturne
statement: Level other towers to 10 once you have points: Poisonic Elder traits A then B.

creator: nocturne
statement: Level Voidinator to 10 with trait B each time.

creator: nocturne
statement: Level Frozone to 10 with trait A each time.

creator: nocturne
statement: Level Kraken towers to 10 with traits B then A.

creator: nocturne
statement: It is okay if leveling these towers takes longer than the first 10 waves.

creator: nocturne
statement: Once everything is level 10 and you have points again level Party Starters to 20 with trait A.

creator: nocturne
statement: Then level all other towers except the Voidinator to 15 selecting trait B at level 15.

creator: nocturne
statement: After all towers are level 15 summon four more Krakens then a Frozone then three more Krakens to finish the line.

creator: nocturne
statement: Level the new towers to 15 using the same traits as before.

creator: nocturne
statement: Level to 20: Poisonic Elder trait B then Krakens trait A on each and Frozone trait A.

creator: nocturne
statement: Do not level the Voidinator past 10 since it will be sold and replaced often later.

creator: nocturne
statement: With excess points maybe level Voidinator to 15 for a small damage increase.

creator: nocturne
statement: Level Party Starters to 25 selecting trait B on each tower.

creator: nocturne
statement: Then level Poisonic Elders to 25 with trait B and Frozone and Krakens to 25 with trait A.

creator: nocturne
statement: Each Kraken tower is very expensive so completing all Krakens takes a few waves.

creator: nocturne
statement: Once everything is level 25 you can sit back and relax until waves 171 to 180 start.

creator: nocturne
statement: Turn on auto attack with the Stop Right There talent on your attack bar so no mobs slip by.

creator: nocturne
statement: After all wave 180 mobs are summoned and Voidinator removed buffs sell it and replace with a Storm Caller at level 25 trait B.

creator: nocturne
statement: Storm Caller effectively doubles damage because it gives 100% crit chance.

creator: nocturne
statement: Use Stop Right There frequently during heavy mob phases of later waves.

creator: nocturne
statement: When few mobs are left sell two Krakens next to the Poisonic Elders and place two more Elders at level 25 with same traits.

creator: nocturne
statement: Extra Poisonic Elders effectively triple DPS for the duration of wave 180.

creator: nocturne
statement: At the start of wave 181 sell the Storm Caller and two extra Poisonic Elders and replace with the Voidinator and Krakens sold before.

creator: nocturne
statement: Wave 190 is fairly easy so no need to sell Voidinator and Krakens but it can help with excess points.

creator: nocturne
statement: Once all wave 200 mobs are summoned sell the Voidinator and replace it with a Poisonic Elder.

creator: nocturne
statement: Mobs spread out in wave 200 so two damage clouds help.

creator: nocturne
statement: Below 100 enemies consider selling end-of-line Krakens and replacing with Party Starters using trait B.

creator: nocturne
statement: Most important is keeping Krakens at or below 0.3 seconds attack speed.

creator: nocturne
statement: If more attack speed is needed select one trait A at a time until reaching the desired speed.

creator: nocturne
statement: With six enemies left have Party Starters on bottom rows mostly trait B and one level 25 Kraken at 0.3 second attack speed.

creator: nocturne
statement: If Frozone slows mobs too much to keep them centered replace it with another Poisonic Elder for more DPS.

creator: nocturne
statement: With three enemies left sell the Kraken and replace in same spot at level 10 with trait B then A to keep enemies centered.

creator: nocturne
statement: With three enemies left and under 580 trillion total mob HP sell all Poisonic Elders and replace with Storm Callers.

creator: nocturne
statement: Level the Storm Callers to 25 with trait A each time as the final DPS mode then wait for end of wave 200.

creator: nocturne
statement: Let wave 201 mobs actually kill the totem and do not forfeit as it can make you lose progress.

creator: nocturne
statement: If towers are strong enough 200 may not be the limit.
